process.name: Resignation Process New
process.documentation: Sales resignation process. Employee creates and submits the resignation form. Then ASE logs it, multi-level resignation and sales clearance approvals run, parallel SBM/FCA/GAD clearances, HR acceptance, and ACC final settlement.

scriptTask.name: Load employee name
scriptTask.documentation: Looks up the starter's full name in Identity (first + last) and stores it as employeeName before the Employee (MPE) task.

userTask.name: Employee (MPE)
userTask.documentation: Employee (MPE / Sr. MPE) creates and submits the resignation form, including the resignation letter for their ASE.

scriptTask.name: Load MPE mail context
scriptTask.documentation: Resolves the ASE display name, case number, and the MPE HTML body so the mail task can evaluate it.

serviceTask.name: Email: Employee (MPE)

userTask.name: ASE: Resignation - ${employeeName} (${employeeId})
userTask.documentation: ASE approves resignation and generates sales clearance, then forwards to RSE.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: ASE

serviceTask.name: Email: ASE: Approve resignation & sales clearance

userTask.name: RSE: Resignation â ${employeeName} (${employeeId})
userTask.documentation: RSE approval. Entry in mSales generates notification mail to recipients. Forward to ZSI.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: RSE

serviceTask.name: Email: RSE: Approve resignation & clearance

scriptTask.name: Load mail: ZSI

serviceTask.name: Email: ZSI: Approve resignation & clearance

scriptTask.name: Load mail: SM

serviceTask.name: Email: SM: Approve resignation & clearance

userTask.name: GM: Resignation â ${employeeName} (${employeeId})
userTask.documentation: GM approves and forwards to SSR (Sales Admin).

scriptTask.name: Load mail: GM

serviceTask.name: Email: GM: Approve resignation & clearance

userTask.name: SSR (Sales Admin): Receive resignation & clearance
userTask.documentation: Receive resignation letter and sales clearance. Split onward: Director Marketing sign on resignation letter; SIMU/IB then SBM on sales clearance.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: SSR (Sales Admin)

serviceTask.name: Email: SSR (Sales Admin): Receive resignation & clearance

userTask.name: Director Marketing: Approve / Sign resignation letter
userTask.documentation: SSR collects Director Marketing signature on the resignation letter, then forwards to HRM.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: Director Marketing

serviceTask.name: Email: Director Marketing: Approve / Sign resignation letter

userTask.name: SIMU / IB: Sales clearance approval
userTask.documentation: SSR collects SIMU and IB approval/clearance on the sales clearance form.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: SIMU / IB

serviceTask.name: Email: SIMU / IB: Sales clearance approval

userTask.name: SBM: Generate SBM clearance
userTask.documentation: Generate SBM clearance, attach sales clearance, forward to HRM.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: SBM

serviceTask.name: Email: SBM: Generate SBM clearance

userTask.name: FCA: Generate FCA clearance
userTask.documentation: Generate FCA clearance and forward to HRM.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: FCA

serviceTask.name: Email: FCA: Generate FCA clearance

userTask.name: GAD: Motorcycle clearance
userTask.documentation: Generate motorcycle clearance and forward to HRM.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: GAD

serviceTask.name: Email: GAD: Motorcycle clearance

userTask.name: HRM: Receive clearance pack
userTask.documentation: Receive total 5 documents: 1. Resignation Letter from SSR (Admin) 2. Sales Clearance from SBM 3. SBM Clearance from SBM 4. Motorcycle Clearance from GAD 5. FCA Clearance from FCA

scriptTask.name: Load mail: HRM

serviceTask.name: Email: HRM: Receive clearance pack

userTask.name: HRM: Draft acceptance of resignation
userTask.documentation: Generate Acceptance of Resignation Letter for Head of HR signature.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: HRM

serviceTask.name: Email: HRM: Draft acceptance of resignation

userTask.name: Head of HR: Approve acceptance letter

scriptTask.name: Load mail: Head of HR

serviceTask.name: Email: Head of HR: Approve acceptance letter

userTask.name: HRM: Circulate acceptance & update records
userTask.documentation: 1. Circulate acceptance (email / shared link to employee and SSR Admin; Reception Box for collection) 2. Update employee Clearance Status Record 3. Compile all docs (6) and send copy to ACC for final settlement

scriptTask.name: Load mail: HRM

serviceTask.name: Email: HRM: Circulate acceptance & update records

userTask.name: ACC Officer: Prepare final settlement
userTask.documentation: Generate Employee Final Settlement Statement (soft form).

scriptTask.name: Load mail: ACC Officer

serviceTask.name: Email: ACC Officer: Prepare final settlement

scriptTask.name: Load mail: ACC Manager

serviceTask.name: Email: ACC Manager: Approve final settlement

scriptTask.name: Load mail: ACC Director

serviceTask.name: Email: ACC Director: Approve final settlement

userTask.name: HRM (ISJ): Update EBS final settlement status
userTask.documentation: Check and update record in EBS (Final Settlement Status).

scriptTask.name: Load mail: HRM (ISJ)

serviceTask.name: Email: HRM (ISJ): Update EBS final settlement status

userTask.name: Head of HR: Sign final settlement
userTask.documentation: Sign Final Settlement and return to ACC.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: Head of HR

serviceTask.name: Email: Head of HR: Sign final settlement

userTask.name: ACC: Complete final settlement
userTask.documentation: Complete final settlement and send a copy to HRM for preservation.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: ACC

serviceTask.name: Email: ACC: Complete final settlement

userTask.name: HRM (ISJ): Preserve employee file
userTask.documentation: Receive copy, attach with other docs (7), share/print/extract PDF as needed, and preserve in the employee file folder.

scriptTask.name: Load mail: HRM (ISJ)

serviceTask.name: Email: HRM (ISJ): Preserve employee file
